sentences.text: Now one that matters to you as a charter captain: engaged in fishing.
Under the rules, it means fishing with nets, lines, trawls or other gear that restricts your ability to maneuver.
And here’s the key: it does not include trolling lines.
You’ve got four lines out, trolling for kingfish along the beach.
Legally you’re just a power-driven vessel.
You get no special privileges, and you keep clear of sailboats like any other powerboat.
Meanwhile, the shrimp boat working her nets nearby is engaged in fishing.
But when that same shrimper stows her nets and heads home, she’s an ordinary power-driven vessel too.
It’s about what the gear is doing, not what kind of boat it is.
